enchantments.tooltip: +3 Enhancement Bonus: +3 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Lesser Elemental Bane: A bane weapon excels at attacking one type or subtype of creature. Against Elementals, this weapon's effective enhancement bonus is +1 better than its normal enhancement bonus. It deals an extra 1 to 6 points of damage against the foe.
Vampirism: This weapon drains a tiny portion of the target's life force whenever it does damage.Note: provides 1d3 hp of healing per hit.
Hardened Spikes: The sharp, hardened spikes on this item deal an additional 4d6 Piercing damage when used to strike an enemy.

Destruction: On Hit: Your target gains a stack of Armor Destruction. (-1 penalty to Armor Class, -1% of its Fortification. 20 Second Duration. Stacks up to 15 times.) This effect may trigger once every three seconds.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
